answer: I did not run the job because garnet has only 20 qubits, so a 30-qubit GHZ circuit cannot fit on it. I checked this live with get_backend(), which costs nothing. Both garnet and garnet:mock report num_qubits = 20, and the docs also list garnet as Crystal 20. I submitted no jobs and used no credits. I did not quietly swap in a smaller circuit or a different QPU, because that would not be the job you asked for. You have two options. The first is a GHZ circuit of 20 qubits or fewer on garnet. The second is the 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits and costs more credits per second.
